title: page
description: One logical page of a bundle (pages/NNNN.json). Text is byte-stable and immutable after first publish; anchors depend on it (DESIGN §4.3, §4.4, §6).

id.description: Zero-padded 4-digit page id, equal to the zero-padded sequence number (e.g. '0007').

seq.description: 1-based page sequence number across the whole book.

chapter.description: 1-based index of the chapter this page belongs to (matches structure.chapters[].index).

text.description:
Final immutable page text: paragraphs joined by '

', NFC-normalized, '
' line endings, no trailing whitespace (DESIGN §6.6). Byte-stable forever — annotation anchors are UTF-16 offsets into this string.

word_count.description: Number of words on this page (whitespace-delimited count used by pagination, DESIGN §6).

ledger.description: Scene-ledger for this page: the 'scene-update' transform output stored verbatim (DESIGN §4.3, §7.1 P3). Opaque provenance — its internal shape is owned by text-transform-service, so it is not constrained here. Present in published bundles; absent in early (P0) work-phase pages, which carry text only.
